<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$a = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$b = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$INF = 1e18;
$dp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, $INF);
$dp[0] = 0;

for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $mod = $i % $n;
    $costOpen = $a[$mod];
    $costClose = $b[$mod];
    $newdp = array_fill(0, $n + 1, $INF);

    for ($bal = 0; $bal <= $n; $bal++) {
        $cur = $dp[$bal];
        if ($cur == $INF) continue;

        // open bracket
        if ($bal + 1 <= $n) {
            $val = $cur + $costOpen;
            if ($val < $newdp[$bal + 1]) $newdp[$bal + 1] = $val;
        }

        // close bracket
        if ($bal > 0) {
            $val = $cur + $costClose;
            if ($val < $newdp[$bal - 1]) $newdp[$bal - 1] = $val;
        }
    }
    $dp = $newdp;
}

echo $dp[0] . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$a = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$b = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$maxBal = $n;
$INF = PHP_INT_MAX;

// dp[balance][pos_mod] = minimal cost
$dp = array_fill(0, $maxBal + 1, array_fill(0, $n, $INF));
$dp[0][0] = 0;

for ($i = 0; $i < $m; $i++) {
    $pos = $i % $n;
    $next = array_fill(0, $maxBal + 1, array_fill(0, $n, $INF));
    for ($bal = 0; $bal <= $maxBal; $bal++) {
        $cur = $dp[$bal][$pos];
        if ($cur == $INF) continue;

        // open bracket
        if ($bal + 1 <= $maxBal) {
            $nbal = $bal + 1;
            $npos = ($pos + 1) % $n;
            $cost = $cur + $a[$pos];
            if ($cost < $next[$nbal][$npos]) {
                $next[$nbal][$npos] = $cost;
            }
        }

        // close bracket (only if balance > 0)
        if ($bal > 0) {
            $nbal = $bal - 1;
            $npos = ($pos + 1) % $n;
            $cost = $cur + $b[$pos];
            if ($cost < $next[$nbal][$npos]) {
                $next[$nbal][$npos] = $cost;
            }
        }
    }
    $dp = $next;
}

echo $dp[0][$m % $n] . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
fscanf(STDIN, "%d %d", $n, $m);
$a = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$b = array_map('intval', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));

$maxBalance = $n;
$INF = PHP_INT_MAX;

// dp[balance][pos] = minimal cost to reach this state within one period (n positions)
$dp = array_fill(0, $maxBalance + 1, array_fill(0, $n, $INF));
$dp[0][0] = 0;

for ($pos = 0; $pos < $n; $pos++) {
    $i = $pos; // index within period
    for ($bal = 0; $bal <= $maxBalance; $bal++) {
        $cur = $dp[$bal][$pos];
        if ($cur == $INF) continue;

        // open bracket
        if ($bal + 1 <= $maxBalance) {
            $nb = $bal + 1;
            $np = ($pos + 1) % $n;
            $cost = $cur + $a[$i];
            if ($cost < $dp[$nb][$np]) $dp[$nb][$np] = $cost;
        }

        // close bracket (only if balance > 0)
        if ($bal > 0) {
            $nb = $bal - 1;
            $np = ($pos + 1) % $n;
            $cost = $cur + $b[$i];
            if ($cost < $dp[$nb][$np]) $dp[$nb][$np] = $cost;
        }
    }
}

// Build transition matrix for one period
$size = $maxBalance + 1;
$trans = array_fill(0, $size, array_fill(0, $size, $INF));
for ($from = 0; $from <= $maxBalance; $from++) {
    for ($to = 0; $to <= $maxBalance; $to++) {
        $trans[$from][$to] = $dp[$to][0];
    }
}

// Matrix multiplication (min-plus)
function matMul($A, $B, $size, $INF) {
    $C = array_fill(0, $size, array_fill(0, $size, $INF));
    for ($i = 0; $i < $size; $i++) {
        for ($k = 0; $k < $size; $k++) {
            if ($A[$i][$k] == $INF) continue;
            $aik = $A[$i][$k];
            for ($j = 0; $j < $size; $j++) {
                if ($B[$k][$j] == $INF) continue;
                $val = $aik + $B[$k][$j];
                if ($val < $C[$i][$j]) $C[$i][$j] = $val;
            }
        }
    }
    return $C;
}

// Matrix exponentiation
$periods = intdiv($m, $n);
$size = $maxBalance + 1;

// identity matrix
$res = array_fill(0, $size, array_fill(0, $size, $INF));
for ($i = 0; $i < $size; $i++) $res[$i][$i] = 0;

$base = $trans;
$e = $periods;
while ($e > 0) {
    if ($e & 1) {
        $res = matMul($res, $base, $size, $INF);
    }
    $base = matMul($base, $base, $size, $INF);
    $e >>= 1;
}

// answer: start from balance 0, end at balance 0
echo $res[0][0] . PHP_EOL;
?>

oai_response.prompt:
Write a program in PHP to solve this programming problem:
Description: Jeff loves regular bracket sequences.Today Jeff is going to take a piece of paper and write out the regular bracket sequence, consisting of nm brackets. Let's number all brackets of this sequence from 0 to nm - 1 from left to right. Jeff knows that he is going to spend ai mod n liters of ink on the i-th bracket of the sequence if he paints it opened and bi mod n liters if he paints it closed.You've got sequences a, b and numbers n, m. What minimum amount of ink will Jeff need to paint a regular bracket sequence of length nm?Operation x mod y means taking the remainder after dividing number x by number y.
Input Specification: The first line contains two integers n and m (1 ≤ n ≤ 20; 1 ≤ m ≤ 107; m is even). The next line contains n integers: a0, a1, ..., an - 1 (1 ≤ ai ≤ 10). The next line contains n integers: b0, b1, ..., bn - 1 (1 ≤ bi ≤ 10). The numbers are separated by spaces.
Output Specification: In a single line print the answer to the problem — the minimum required amount of ink in liters.

Sample Input:
2 6
1 2
2 1
Sample Output:
12

Sample Input:
1 10000000
2
3
Sample Output:
25000000

Notes: NoteIn the first test the optimal sequence is: ()()()()()(), the required number of ink liters is 12.
Take input from standard input and output to standard output
Provide the PHP code without any extra description or tokens. Target code:
